name: LLM Wiki
description: Builds and maintains an interlinked wiki from your documents in a desktop app, and exposes hybrid search, graph and file reads to agents through a local HTTP API and MCP server.

skills.name: Local HTTP API
skills.description: Serves a token-protected JSON API on 127.0.0.1:19828 for hybrid search, file reads, graph traversal, rescans and SSE-streamed agent chat.

skills.name: MCP Server
skills.description: Bundles a local MCP server that calls the same API, with a copyable client config shown in Settings, API + MCP.

skills.name: Deep Research
skills.description: Generates research topics from the wiki, runs multi-query web search via Tavily, SerpApi or SearXNG, and ingests the results.

skills.name: Graph Insights
skills.description: Detects communities in the wikilink graph with Louvain clustering and surfaces surprising connections and knowledge gaps.

skills.name: Web Clipper
skills.description: Clips the current browser page into a chosen wiki project as Markdown through an unpacked Chrome extension and a local API.
